title: Torelli Theorem for moduli stacks of vector bundles on tame Deligne Mumford curves
summary: We prove a Torelli theorem for full moduli stacks of vector bundles of rank at least three with fixed determinant on a smooth, proper, geometrically connected, tame Deligne--Mumford curve of coarse genus at least two over an arbitrary field $k$. We also prove a Torelli theorem for the full moduli stack of vector bundles of rank at least three of fixed-degree under an explicit compatibility hypothesis.
